name: Standing in the Fire (Lập Hỏa Tam Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Burn and Get Back Up (Phần Nhi Khởi)
bonuses.rule: each time your body shield breaks, you regain 15 % of your health, and your next fist strike deals extra Fire damage equal to the shield's value. Once a fight, while you wear the Xích Hà Kỳ, a blow that would knock you out leaves you standing at a third of your health.

story: Two pieces are his own, from the day in 1020 he stood in the vent. The third is the Xích Hà Kỳ, which is not his: Phượng Minh lent it out of the Hall of Spoils, and Xích Thành wove it. The set is whole only while the palace's loan stands.

name: Master of the Sittings (Tọa Sư Tam Bảo)

bonuses.rule: each hit you block or take on your body shield adds one heat to your store. At ten heat your next fist strike releases it all as Fire damage, and for 3 s the foe, when it strikes you, takes a Burn batch.

story: The ring from the day he became an elder, the mail of the sitting stones and the board shield from the Fire Court's steps. He holds all three, and the hall reads the board as a sign of where his friends are.
